name: 38120 · Memphis, TN
findings: ZIP 38120 (Memphis) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38120 (Memphis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 38120 (Memphis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
